summary: The sealed source/text supports four accepted full50 endpoints and two registered MSVR M0 acceptance failures. Both available pretrained-versus-random primary comparisons are negative. No direct artifact contradiction or circular retrieval score scaling was found. Limited reporting is supported; broader efficacy/reproduction claims are not.
context_boundary: Fresh delegated audit task; no MEMORY.md or prior auditor verdict was loaded. Global workspace startup instructions caused reads of SOUL.md, USER.md and daily workspace notes before the audit prompt; these were excluded as evidence. This is therefore disclosed rather than labeled strictly zero-context.

A.name: Ground-truth provenance
A.details: For the inspected source/text scope, formal fused and own-global scores use protocol identity/camera metadata from dataset filenames; MSVR uses scene filtering. All protocol rows were parsed and all queries have legal positives. No model-generated reference substitutes for retrieval GT. Original image bytes and source dataset inventory are not locally reauthenticated.

B.name: Score normalization
B.details: L2 normalizes features before squared Euclidean distance. AP is normalized by dataset-relevant positives and CMC by valid queries, then converted to percent. Lower distance is better; higher mAP/CMC is better. No division of retrieval performance by the model own maximum/mean was found in the active scoring path.

C.name: Result existence and consistency
C.details: Four accepted full50 endpoints, 200 formal epochs and 11,556 updates agree across receipts, histories and streamed JSONL. Six producer M0 runs each performed 8 updates; both MSVR isolated-gradient acceptances failed and have no formal endpoint. All 14 paired summaries recompute from supplied AP/rank arrays. Physical checkpoint and distance binaries are absent locally; receipt agreement is not an independent binary rescore.

D.name: Active code and instrumentation
D.details: The configured main/evaluate/report call chain invokes the inspected scorers and paired analysis. Same-forward global collection is active only in final evaluation. Training observers return detached diagnostics and leave model/loss outputs in the declared path; their synchronization contributes runtime. Gradient records must distinguish actual backward from separate scaled isolated VJP and cumulative weight change.

E.name: Scope and claim strength
E.details: One training seed and one fixed random text package; two comparable datasets and four completed full50 conditions. Each model is selected on its official query/gallery mAP across 50 epochs. Both available primary pretrained-minus-random contrasts are negative. No stability, general text necessity, strict global trajectory preservation, layer/word attribution, novelty, SOTA or overall target attainment follows.

F.name: Evaluation type classification
F.details: Formal retrieval and AP/rank comparisons are real_gt. Prefix equivalence is synthetic_proxy. Real-batch M0 is engineering activity/reload support, not a retrieval result. Unlabeled feature/attention statistics are self_supervised_proxy diagnostics; identity-grouped cosine remains a model-derived proxy with real training labels.

findings.title: Registered campaign closes with two missing endpoints
findings.detail: Report COMPLETE and report exit 0 describe a completed report. Campaign COMPLETE_WITH_MISSING and controller exit 1 remain correct. Both MSVR producers say M0_PASS and have eight updates, but all four psi isolated-task-gradient tensors remain zero on steps 2-8, so accept-m0 fails at source line 101. No MSVR full50 or score may be filled with a historical control, zero, or producer status.

findings.title: Local evidence supports a text audit, not new binary reproduction
findings.detail: All 433 source hashes match both campaign pins and archive; all 144 result files match the terminal archive. Four selected checkpoints and associated distance matrices are referenced by hashes but not present in the local manifest bundle. AP/rank arithmetic is recomputed independently, but AP generation from raw distances and inference from weights are not rerun.

findings.title: Pretraining benefit is not supported in this fixed contrast
findings.detail: Pretrained minus random is -0.1221373414 mAP / -0.4784688995 R1 points on RGBNT201, and -0.3407858314 mAP / -0.8746355685 R1 points on RGBNT100. There are 0 successful primary progression comparisons among 2 available; the third registered comparison is missing. The +0.5 mAP and nonnegative R1 rule is a progression rule, not significance.

findings.title: Parameter movement and gradient-path attribution are different evidence
findings.detail: First formal update: all five logged text parameter gradients are exactly zero while all five cumulative deltas are positive. Adam weight decay is nonzero in the recorded recipe, so movement alone cannot prove task-gradient activity. Subsequent actual backward gradients are nonzero, while MSVR separate isolated VJPs for psi remain zero. The different computations are not an isolated numerical-cause experiment; neither an entirely disconnected branch nor a uniquely located underflow cause follows.

findings.title: Gradient ownership does not certify identical global training trajectories
findings.detail: Source detaches shared features and head parameters in the fused role loss, but this is a gradient ownership property. The supplied same-epoch RGBNT100 E5 comparison records own-global mAP 84.0835133277 versus independent global 84.3692249991 (-0.2857116714 points). RGBNT201 selected query summaries agree across own-global arms; neither fact proves all weights, augmentations, optimizer moments or full trajectories identical. The audited loop has no full-model gradient clipping and asserts no scaler decrease; neither should be invented as the observed difference cause.

findings.title: The supplied handoff ends at the dated pre-launch state
findings.detail: The supplied claim document ends at section 41.901 (2026-10-10 01:05), explicitly saying new M0/fresh50 had not yet run. That is a dated historical statement, not evidence contradicting later terminal records. Append a terminal status with the new counts and limits before using this handoff as the current result summary; preserve the historical section.
